target.name: delta_p
target.population: S1 original primary events with forward first-visit exit

subset_rule: nested SHA-256 event_uid ranking within the fixed source train pool; no y-based sampling

preprocessing.fit_scope: each current D_n train subset only
preprocessing.learned_center: degree-3 polynomial ridge with frozen alpha grid and deterministic 3-fold inner CV

optimization.checkpoint_rule: argmin source-validation all-event Y-space NLL within fixed 20000-update budget
optimization.gradient_record: pre-clip norm at every validation point
optimization.paired_initialization: same network initialization hash for a representation/capacity/seed across sample fractions where the seed is shared
optimization.paired_batch_order: same seed-driven event permutation rule across representations and capacities

likelihood.survival: [1-F_q(z|X)]-[1-F_q(b|X)] in stable log space, normalized by F_q(b|X)
